To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the FIACRE software allows the automated monitoring of bioprocesses on the basis of FIA and biosensors.

(i) a computer-controlled FIA/biosensorsystem can be developed that allows the monitoring of various substrates during cell cultivations, (ii) the sensors applied can be modified for use in real cultivation media, (iii) the software FIACre can be adapted to other sensors and (iv) the FIA system can be used for the control of a bioprocess.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a computer controlled FIA system for the monitoring and control of bioprocesses.
the development of a flexible FIA/biosensors system, which is controlled by a microcomputer, for bioprocess monitoring.
the development of new optical sensors, the adaptation of already existing ones and their application in bioprocess monitoring.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
FIA/biosensors are well suitable for the monitoring of cell cultivation and bioprocesses.
the software presented here is an important step in the direction of a computer-controlled FIA/biosensing system for the monitoring and control of biotechnical processes.
FIA/biosensors are a promising and flexible technique for process monitoring in biotechnology.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
FIA/biosensors can be used for bioprocess monitoring and that the FIACRE software can be used for controlling the FIA system.
FIA/biosensors are very useful for bioprocess monitoring.
FIA/biosensing systems for bioprocess monitoring and control are possible and that the software FIACCRE is an appropriate tool for this purpose.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a FIA/biosensing system can be used for the monitoring of a cell cultivation and the addition of substrate can be controlled by the computer.
the combination of different sensors and the use of different sensing principles in one FIA system is a very powerful tool for the monitoring of bioprocesses.
a computer-controlled flow injection analysis (C-FIA) system can be employed for the monitoring of complex bioprocesses.
